Dana Li: owners: Dana (launch), Samir (bench), Jamie (tutorial + routing). repo-bot create refs/lightning-refapp please.

repo-bot: Branch created: refs/lightning-refapp. Files: run.sh, README.md.

Maya Patel: schedule: publish Wed 10am PT. Marketing will host assets under /assets/lightning/. Samir — ask finance if you need credits.

Samir Rao: will ping finance now.
